czech-republic.title: Flag of the Czech Republic

colors.note: Symbolizes loyalty and the historical Czech lands

desc: - Two horizontal stripes of white and red with a blue isosceles triangle at the hoist extending to the midpoint
- Retained from the former Czechoslovak flag upon independence in 1993
trivia:
- The white and red were historically from the Bohemian kingdom; the blue was added from Moravia
- The wedge (triquetra) on the left creates a unique geometric profile
- Adopted in 1990 after the Velvet Revolution separated Czechoslovakia
